summary: Postinstall and require-time beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package declares a postinstall script that runs beacon.cjs, and the same beacon is also invoked from index.js at require() time. beacon.cjs POSTs the installer's hostname (os.hostname()), install directory (__dirname), current working directory (process.cwd()), and Node version to the hardcoded plain-HTTP bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The package exports a Proxy that returns no-ops and provides no real functionality, matching a dependency-confusion / name-squat lure shape. Comments in beacon.cjs describe it as a 'build-provenance beacon' that collects 'no data beyond that', directly contradicting the host-identifier payload actually sent to a non-first-party IP endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
